title: The last load
logline: The last truck out of the yard, 1994: a flatbed of cedar under chains, the driver's arm out the window, the yard behind it empty of logs for the first time. The gate open. Era I spotting on the tires.

panels.composition: A log truck loaded with cedar under chains leaving a mill yard through an open gate, the driver's arm out the window, the yard behind empty of logs for the first time, the stack not smoking.
